evidence: Implements an in-tree unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates src/test/main.cpp.
rationale: Replaces the external Boost.Test library with a native C++ unit test runner and assertion framework, resolving long-standing maintainability issues (#8670, #34666) and signal stack quirks (#36045). It provides automated operand logging on failure and removes barriers to test concurrency and linter integration (IWYU, clang-tidy).
